retention_classes.label: Preview short-lived
retention_classes.durable_identity_posture: Digest still identifies the artifact, but preview artifacts are disposable and never production truth.

retention_classes.label: Verification window
retention_classes.durable_identity_posture: Retained long enough for integration replay, audit, and drift analysis.
retention_classes.rollback_reference_posture: Rollback allowed only inside non-production lanes.

retention_classes.label: Release long tail
retention_classes.durable_identity_posture: Promotable packages and release rollback digests remain addressable for a full release horizon.
retention_classes.rollback_reference_posture: Rollback points always reference prior admitted digests, never floating tags.

retention_classes.label: Evidence append-only
retention_classes.durable_identity_posture: SBOM, provenance, and release-admission records are append-only audit material.
retention_classes.rollback_reference_posture: Evidence is never overwritten or garbage-collected on a normal release cadence.

notes: Preview lanes cannot directly promote artifacts.
Digest copy is allowed once verification evidence is complete.
Production promotion binds to the exact preproduction-tested digest and candidate tuple.

truth_statement: Registry promotion moves digests, not mutable tags; evidence namespaces remain append-only and independently addressable.
notes: Rollback references remain previously admitted digests plus the release-admission manifest that named them.

source_refs.rationale: Release integrity requires digest, signature, provenance, and runtime verification instead of mutable CI dashboards.
Promotion copies exact tested digests forward and never redefines truth by mutable tag movement.
Release candidates require signature verification, provenance, SBOM, vulnerability posture, and notarization where applicable.
Mixed-candidate evidence must be rejected and candidate identity remains hash-based.
